info.name: PaperNotes
info.summary: Viewer and PDF export for PaperNotes (.pnote) notebook files
info.description: PaperNotes integration for Nextcloud. - Open and read .pnote notebook files directly in the browser - Faithful rendering of all 21 background templates (lines, grids, plans, meeting notes, cornell notes) - Crisp vector stroke rendering and full page navigation - Text boxes (rich text) and images in viewer and PDF, recordings as player below the page - High-quality vector PDF download, optionally with the recordings attached to the pages - Robust security with strict size limits and path traversal protection
info.author: hjochman
